# Phase Two — Gevurah Scope

## Product files expected
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/core/httpResponse.js` — new Olam transport adapter using the framework's `makeJsonResponse`.
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/_awtsmoos.derech.js` — full rewrite so every handler result passes through the adapter.

## Test files expected
- `geelooy/apps/olam-h3/tests/http-response-contract.test.mjs` — proves Olam adapter + actual dynamic-response normalizer/sender propagate status.
- Optional browser image-update smoke only if existing deterministic coverage cannot prove fresh transport bytes. Existing tests already do prove that invariant, so do not add redundant UI automation unless runtime inspection reveals a gap.

## Non-touch list
- provider client
- mapper
- validation
- handlers
- browser proxy
- asset replacement
- preview cache
- generation queue
- global `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer`

Public JSON error shape remains unchanged for backward compatibility.
